scope: Image/video provider marking and EU deployer deepfake disclosure; requirements planning, not a legal determination

EU-50.basis: Current Commission reproduction of consolidated AI Act2026-07-27, Article50(2),(4),(5) re-read2026-11-06; direct EUR-Lex robot gate not bypassed.

EU-TIMING.basis: Article 111(4), introduced by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744; pre-2026-08-02 provider systems comply with 50(2) by 2026-12-02. Official Commission reproduction read 2026-11-05; direct OJ access unavailable.

EU-CODE.basis: Final voluntary Code, 2026-06-10; Measures 1.1 and 3.4 reviewed from official PDF on 2026-11-05. Signatory interoperability solution under 3.4(c) by 2027-02-02; full Code adherence not evaluated.

CA-22757.basis: Official consolidated BPC Chapter25 re-read in browser2026-11-06; SB1000 amendment notes effective2026-09-30. Sections22757.2/.3 require no-cost upload OR URL + programmatic verifier, system-only disclosure, feedback, minimization and latent durability. Provider scope partial; other roles excluded.

SDK.basis: C2PA + watermark is the SDK implementation, not a statutory mandate to use these particular algorithms

EU-GUIDANCE.basis: Commission final Article50 guidelines, library updated2026-11-05; sections4.2.1–4.2.3 read from the official PDF2026-11-06.
